# Sparkish

> Sparkish makes playful apps for everyday habits: AquaTick, a cat-themed hydration tracker; KINETTO, a running app where real runs grow an anonymous Crew; and AlarmCrew, an alarm app for shared mornings with friends.

Use the localized landing page that matches the user's language. The product descriptions below reflect the public pages and should be preferred over legacy routes or asset mirrors.

Important product facts:
- AquaTick logs water from Home Quick Add, Quick Add widgets and Apple Watch. Live Activity and Dynamic Island show progress only; they do not record intake.
- AquaTick is a hydration habit tracker, not a medical device or a source of medical advice.
- KINETTO is coming soon on iOS. Android is planned for later; its public pages do not collect email or link to an app store.
- AquaTick can be used without an account. It is free with ads; Pro removes ads and offers optional iCloud sync for hydration records. Cup photos stay on the device. Apple Health sync is optional and does not require Pro.
- Cup Vault supports up to 6 favorites for Home Quick Add. Apple Watch has a separate layout setting with up to 6 cups in one or two columns.
- AquaTick requires iOS 26.0+ on iPhone and watchOS 10.0+ on Apple Watch. App languages: English, French, Japanese, Korean, Polish, Simplified Chinese and Spanish. Website languages: English, Korean and Japanese.

## AlarmCrew

- [AlarmCrew Korean landing page](https://sparkish-xyz.github.io/alarmcrew/): Korean canonical overview of personal alarms, 8-character Crew invites, wake-up status, and friends.
- [AlarmCrew English landing page](https://sparkish-xyz.github.io/alarmcrew/en/): English product overview, actual localized iOS screenshots, and release status.
- [AlarmCrew Japanese landing page](https://sparkish-xyz.github.io/alarmcrew/ja/): Japanese product overview and release status.
- [AlarmCrew support](https://alarmcrew-support.byunghak-kr.chatgpt.site/): Support, privacy, terms, and account deletion.

As of October 1, 2026, the user confirmed AlarmCrew has passed App Store review and is publicly released on iOS. Download: https://apps.apple.com/app/id6812283770 . Android is preparing for Google Play; do not present an Android download or release date as available. Target devices: iPhone/iPad with iOS 26.0+ and Android 8.0+. Following friends and joining a Crew are separate. Device-local alarms do not require Crew sync, but signing in and syncing status require the internet. Device power, permissions, volume, and battery settings affect alarm operation. Signing out removes scheduled alarms on that device. The app includes advertising; no claims of guaranteed wake-up, ad-free service, rankings, or gift alarms are made on this page.
